subtitle: Third-Party Resources, 3D Models, Software Frameworks, Attribution Information and License Notices
content: CREDITS, THIRD-PARTY ASSETS & ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS Welcome to the official credits and third-party asset information section for GREAT STREETS. This page provides general information about selected third-party resources, 3D models, development technologies, software frameworks, and other materials that may be incorporated into or associated with the project. GREAT STREETS is an independently developed interactive game project. The development team acknowledges the work of independent artists, 3D model creators, programmers, software developers, open-source contributors, and creative communities whose resources and tools can support game development. The purpose of this page is to document known third-party contributions, provide relevant creator attribution, identify referenced resources, and acknowledge the technologies used during development. Individual assets may be subject to different licensing conditions, attribution requirements, restrictions, or permissions. The inclusion of an asset on this page does not independently establish or expand any license granted by its original creator. SECTION 01 — THIRD-PARTY 3D MODELS AND DIGITAL ASSETS 1.1 VEHICLES, CARS, TRUCKS AND TRANSPORTATION MODELS The following entries identify vehicle-related models and their credited creators or publishers, based on the available project attribution records. These resources are referenced for asset identification and attribution purposes. Chrysler 300 SRT8 Creator / Publisher: Mona x Supercars (@Car2022) Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/chrysler-300-srt8-8b89fb7531314c08917e1d73eae33886 Dodge Charger SRT8 (LD) Creator / Publisher: Mona x Supercars (@Car2022) Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dodge-charger-srt8-ld-264bca6cac51466e8e7e1ce872a7cb09 Aston Martin V12 Vantage Creator / Publisher: Mona x Supercars (@Car2022) Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/aston-martin-v12-vantage-cdef8d1f68084797a717f8942a901497 Chrysler 300C SRT8 Creator / Publisher: Ricy (@ngon_3d) Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/chrysler-300c-srt8-13b19afce8bd4623a7abd591cee41fc0 Low Poly Truck Creator / Publisher: FS 3D Studio (@mwaqasmalik11221122) Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/low-poly-truck-d61a2ac0a706462ebf82459907f21573 Tri-County Sanitation Rear Loader Creator / Publisher: elikev247 Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/tri-county-sanitation-rear-loader-4386388d46f440d8a6687bb56ae0e15f European Delivery Van Creator / Publisher: teacherap123 Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/european-delivery-van-14399c860401445681b88095c6c3abf3 Graffiti Van Creator / Publisher: Aiden__R NC (@roo17217569) Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/graffiti-van-8e0e43ffb5e94db792fcd3e323b110ad Airport Catering Truck Creator / Publisher: rwy00 Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/airport-catering-truck-289f4e2cfa3f4722b0476b1fc37681d8 Lightbody Lifted '85 Creator / Publisher: Daniel Zhabotinsky Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/lightbody-lifted-85-low-poly-model-67beae18c3d24be68f9c8f0ec382d8e3 1.2 CITY ENVIRONMENT, STREET PROPS AND DECORATIVE OBJECTS Urban environments are composed of multiple visual elements that may include street furniture, environmental details, decorative objects, vegetation, signs, and other scene components. The following resources are recorded as part of the project's third-party asset references. Traffic Signs Creator / Publisher: Cybertron B-127 (@robo-reboot) Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/traffic-signs-7efee0295db544b7bcff19359f2e27a1 BAR Sign Board Creator / Publisher: alina_dreiman Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bar-sign-board-9c350441b24a44deb924487a92b52b33 Trash Can / Garbage Can / Rubbish Bin Creator / Publisher: mezuna Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/trash-can-garbage-can-box-rubbish-bin-a3a13e34c0954582b49f8af3524e4475 Waste Can Creator / Publisher: AK STUDIO Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/waste-can-dc93abf5f12647328234636f1286dc03 Old Paper and Cardboard Boxes Creator / Publisher: TooManyDemons Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/old-paper-cardboard-boxes-72a4804f8a4d4de18e59abb60b81c54f Palm Tree Pack Creator / Publisher: EFX Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/palm-tree-pack-lowpoly-fd439b0f82c34497aabb21c68ad2fb34 Fern Grass 02 Creator / Publisher: POLYSCAN Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fern-grass-02-93d1f6a261e24b8394d0ea41cf985ef9 Liberty Ship Creator / Publisher: AlanTinka Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/liberty-ship-a1db8e8414464c5d8b11383e202fcf26 1.3 GAMEPLAY OBJECTS, JOB SYSTEMS AND INTERACTIVE PROPS Interactive environments may include objects associated with in-game activities, fictional economic systems, inventory interactions, environmental storytelling, and mission-based gameplay. The following entries identify referenced models that may be associated with these categories. Lowpoly Safebox Creator / Publisher: matoteus Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/lowpoly-safebox-c9f0fb73f30145409a86f9bcda38fbad Briefcase with Money — Low Poly, Game Ready Creator / Publisher: TampaJoey Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/briefcase-with-money-low-poly-game-ready-875a8474ced44d59944371da837a23ba Dollars Money Creator / Publisher: cs (@DevFaisal) Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dollars-money-b4c255d55dfa45118b965a41cfa29fcb CC0 Magnet Card Creator / Publisher: plaggy Declared License in Source Record: CC0 Public Domain Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/cc0-magnet-card-cd30d8a0aef14fdba16ea317d3f8ceed 1.4 CHARACTER CLOTHING AND CUSTOMIZATION ASSETS Character customization can include clothing, outfits, wearable objects, and other appearance-related resources. Third-party models are credited according to the available asset records, while any modifications, rigging, materials, or integration work may be handled separately during development. Jumpsuit — Low Poly, Game Ready Creator / Publisher: Striker14 Reference: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/jumpsuit-low-poly-game-ready-striker14-da288adbddf949aa85962968732f0999 SECTION 02 — ASSET ATTRIBUTION AND LICENSE INFORMATION 2.1 CREATOR ATTRIBUTION The creators and publishers listed above are credited in accordance with the information available in the project's asset records. Where possible, the corresponding source page is provided so that users can identify the original publication and review the creator's current license information. Attribution details can include the asset title, creator name, publisher name, source URL, and applicable license designation. Additional information may be required by the individual license, including a license link, a copyright notice, an indication of modifications, or other attribution wording. 2.2 CREATIVE COMMONS LICENSES Creative Commons licenses are published legal instruments that define specific permissions and conditions for using copyrighted material. Different Creative Commons license types have different requirements. A CC BY license generally requires appropriate credit, a link to the license, and an indication of changes where applicable. A CC0 dedication is intended to waive copyright and related rights to the extent legally possible. The exact license attached to an individual model must be verified on its original source page. The presence of a model on Sketchfab, or its appearance in a general asset list, does not automatically mean that it is licensed under CC BY or CC0. Some assets may be governed by other licenses, platform terms, or separate permissions. 2.3 THIRD-PARTY OWNERSHIP Unless expressly stated otherwise, third-party assets remain subject to the ownership and rights of their respective authors or rights holders. The inclusion of a resource in GREAT STREETS does not imply that the project owns the original model, source artwork, brand identity, trademark, or other intellectual property associated with that resource. 2.4 MODIFICATIONS AND INTEGRATION A third-party resource may be adapted for technical compatibility, performance, visual consistency, or gameplay integration where the applicable license permits such changes. Adaptations may include adjustments to scale, materials, textures, collision geometry, level of detail, rigging, animation, lighting, or other implementation details. Any statement about modifications should reflect the actual changes made to the relevant asset. No modification, conversion, or inclusion in a game overrides the original license conditions. 2.5 VERIFICATION AND RECORD KEEPING Asset information may change over time because creators can update descriptions, replace files, change distribution terms, or remove publicly accessible pages. The original source page and the license applicable when an asset was obtained should be retained in the project's development records whenever possible. Where attribution information is incomplete or a license cannot be verified, the relevant asset should be reviewed before distribution. If required, the project team may replace the resource, obtain additional permission, or update the credits information to reflect verified details. SECTION 03 — GAME ENGINE, SOFTWARE AND DEVELOPMENT FRAMEWORKS 3.1 UNITY ENGINE Technology: Unity Engine Developer / Rights Holder: Unity Technologies Official Website: https://unity.com Unity provides the real-time development environment used to build interactive applications and games. The engine supports scene management, rendering, physics, input processing, asset importing, scripting, deployment, and other development workflows. Unity remains the property of its respective rights holders and is used subject to the applicable Unity license and terms. 3.2 UNIVERSAL RENDER PIPELINE (URP) Technology: Universal Render Pipeline Developer: Unity Technologies Official Documentation: https://docs.unity3d.com URP is a configurable rendering pipeline designed to support a range of supported platforms and hardware configurations. Rendering settings, shaders, lighting, materials, post-processing, and performance optimizations may be configured according to the requirements of GREAT STREETS and its target devices. 3.3 FISH-NET NETWORKING Technology: FishNet Networking Engine Developer / Publisher: FirstGearGames Official Website: https://fish-networking.gitbook.io/docs FishNet is a networking framework designed to support multiplayer game development. Networking features may include communication between connected players, synchronized gameplay state, networked objects, ownership management, and related multiplayer functionality. The applicable version, package dependencies, and license information should be confirmed against the package actually included in the project. Version information: The project record identifies FishNet v6.5. This entry should be updated if the shipped project uses a different version or replaces the framework. 3.4 FIREBASE SDK AND AUTHENTICATION Technology: Firebase SDK and Authentication Developer / Provider: Google LLC Official Website: https://firebase.google.com Firebase provides development services that can support authentication and other application-related backend functionality. The specific services used by the project depend on the implemented configuration. Individual Firebase SDK components and dependencies may have separate license notices and terms. The reference to Firebase does not mean that Google operates, endorses, or assumes responsibility for GREAT STREETS. Google and Firebase names and logos remain subject to their respective intellectual property rights and usage guidelines. 3.5 TEXTMESH PRO Technology: TextMesh Pro Developer: Unity Technologies Official Documentation: https://docs.unity3d.com TextMesh Pro provides text rendering and typography functionality for supported Unity projects. It may be used for user interface elements, menus, labels, in-game messages, and other text-related presentation. The applicable package and font licenses govern the use of included fonts and other bundled resources. 3.6 CINEMACHINE Technology: Cinemachine Developer: Unity Technologies Official Documentation: https://docs.unity3d.com Cinemachine provides camera tools for Unity applications. Depending on the project's implementation, these tools may support gameplay cameras, follow behavior, camera transitions, framing, and other camera-related functionality. SECTION 04 — AUDIO, SOUND EFFECTS AND CREATIVE RESOURCES 4.1 FREESOUND Resource Platform: Freesound Official Website: https://freesound.org Freesound is a platform where contributors publish sound recordings and audio resources under different licenses. Individual recordings may use different Creative Commons license types or other terms. The license of each specific sound must be checked separately, and any required attribution must be provided according to that license. 4.2 OPENGAMEART Resource Platform: OpenGameArt.org Official Website: https://opengameart.org OpenGameArt hosts artwork, audio, music, textures, and other resources intended for game-related projects. The terms associated with each resource vary according to its individual license. Users must consult the relevant asset page and comply with the applicable conditions before redistribution or commercial use. 4.3 AUDIO AND SOUND EFFECT ACKNOWLEDGEMENT Audio resources, sound effects, music tracks, ambient recordings, and related creative materials may originate from third-party contributors or independently created project content. Credits should identify the actual creator, title, source, and license when these details are available and required. The general acknowledgement of Freesound or OpenGameArt does not replace the attribution requirements of individual audio files. Any resource requiring specific credit wording should be listed with that wording in the appropriate credits record. SECTION 05 — INDEPENDENT DEVELOPMENT AND PROJECT CONTRIBUTIONS 5.1 GREAT STREETS GREAT STREETS is an independently developed game project. Project-specific programming, gameplay systems, configuration, scene composition, integration, optimization, original presentation, and other development work may be produced by the project team or its contributors. Third-party tools and assets are used as separate components of the development process. Their presence does not imply that their original creators participated in the development of GREAT STREETS or formally endorsed the project. 5.2 PROJECT CONTRIBUTORS The project's internal contributor credits may include programming, gameplay implementation, level design, environment setup, asset integration, networking, testing, optimization, visual presentation, and promotional work. Contributor names and roles should be listed according to their actual participation and any agreed credit preferences. 5.3 ORIGINAL AND THIRD-PARTY MATERIALS Original project content and third-party materials may coexist within the same application. Their respective ownership and licensing conditions remain distinct. Permission to use one component does not grant permission to copy, extract, redistribute, or reuse another component unless its applicable terms permit that use. SECTION 06 — TRADEMARKS, BRANDS AND THIRD-PARTY REFERENCES Names of vehicles, companies, software packages, development platforms, products, and other identifiable entities may be used in this document solely to identify relevant referenced assets, technologies, or sources. Their respective names, trademarks, logos, and associated rights belong to their applicable owners. Mentioning a vehicle manufacturer or model name does not establish a commercial relationship, sponsorship, partnership, approval, or endorsement by that manufacturer. Likewise, acknowledging a software package or content platform does not establish a partnership or endorsement by its developer or operator. The project does not claim ownership of third-party trademarks merely because a related model, reference, or technology is included in the project records. Any product names or marks are included for identification and attribution purposes where applicable. SECTION 07 — DISTRIBUTION, REDISTRIBUTION AND LICENSE COMPLIANCE 7.1 DISTRIBUTION OF THE GAME GREAT STREETS may be distributed through supported digital distribution platforms, subject to the relevant platform rules, project requirements, and applicable third-party licenses. Distribution of the complete game does not automatically grant users the right to extract, republish, sell, sublicense, or independently redistribute third-party assets contained within the game. 7.2 EXTRACTED ASSETS Unless an applicable license expressly permits the relevant activity, users should not assume that models, textures, audio files, source files, or other bundled resources may be extracted and reused independently. A license that permits an asset to be used in a game may impose different conditions on standalone redistribution or resale. 7.3 OPEN-SOURCE SOFTWARE Open-source software is governed by its own license terms. Different components may use different licenses, and some packages may include additional dependencies with separate conditions. A general reference to open-source software should not be interpreted as a claim that every component in the project is released under the same license. 7.4 THIRD-PARTY LICENSES Where required, the applicable license text, copyright notice, attribution statement, source reference, and modification notice should be made available in an appropriate location. This page is intended as an informational credits record and does not replace the original license text or the requirements imposed by the relevant rights holder. SECTION 08 — ACCURACY, UPDATES AND CONTACT 8.1 INFORMATION ACCURACY The information presented on this page is based on the project's available attribution records and the references listed above. Although care should be taken to maintain accurate credits, descriptions and third-party license information may require correction, verification, or updating. The asset title, creator attribution, license designation, software version, and source URL should be checked against the relevant official source before a final distribution release. Any outdated, incomplete, or inaccurate information should be corrected when identified. 8.2 UPDATES This credits record may be revised when new assets are incorporated, existing resources are removed or replaced, software packages are updated, attribution details change, or additional contributors are recognized. The last-updated field identifies the recorded revision date of this document and does not independently certify the current validity of every external license. 8.3 CONTACT AND ATTRIBUTION CORRECTIONS Creators or rights holders who believe that an attribution entry is incomplete or inaccurate may contact the project team through its official communication channels and provide the relevant asset URL, ownership information, license details, and requested correction. Requests can then be reviewed against the available project records and applicable terms. SECTION 09 — GENERAL DISCLAIMER This page is provided to acknowledge referenced creators, development tools, third-party resources, and software technologies. It is not a substitute for legal advice, a complete inventory of every dependency, or a representation that every listed item has been independently audited. License obligations are determined by the actual terms applicable to each resource, not solely by the wording of this credits page. Where an asset's license or ownership status is uncertain, its use should be verified before publication or distribution. All third-party names, references, and materials remain subject to the rights and conditions applicable to them. Nothing in this page is intended to remove, limit, or override rights that belong to third-party authors, developers, publishers, or rights holders. FINAL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT We acknowledge the artists, creators, developers, open-source contributors, audio producers, and software teams whose work supports the wider game development ecosystem. Their tools, resources, and creative contributions help developers build interactive experiences and continue improving their projects. Thank you to the creators and communities who share their work and make digital development resources available to other developers. GREAT STREETS recognizes the importance of appropriate attribution, responsible asset usage, license awareness, and respect for the intellectual property rights of others.
